title: MACHINE SMOKE READS AT 1080P
why: His photo of v34.78 (one bulwark at 40 percent, one at 10) showed no smoke. The puffs started at the top of the body and rose into the name plate that is drawn over them, and they were small, 0.4 opaque and dark on dark ground. They now start on the upper body, are bigger, 0.7 opaque (0.85 near death) with a light grey rim.
now: A hurt machine trails clear dark smoke from its body.
